Check with \(\vec{a} = \hat{i}, \vec{b} = \hat{j}, \vec{c} = \hat{i}\): \((\hat{i} \times \hat{j}) \times \hat{i} = \hat{k} \times \hat{i} = \hat{j}\), and the formula gives \(\hat{j}(1) - \hat{i}(0) = \hat{j}\).
